title: Group Words by Anagram
description:
Group words that are anagrams of one another. Return a list of groups in the order each group first appears in the input. Keep words inside each group in their original order. Matching is case-sensitive.

For example, `["eat", "tea", "tan", "ate"]` becomes `[["eat", "tea", "ate"], ["tan"]]`. Return an empty list for empty input.

solution.explanation: Sorting the letters of a word creates a shared key for its anagrams. Store words in a dictionary under that key, appending them in input order. Dictionary insertion order preserves the order in which groups first appear.
